title: distephanus eriophyllus
intro: Distephanus eriophyllus, commonly known as African wormwood, is a plant species native to tropical Africa, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Distephanus eriophyllus include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include stimulating digestion, reducing fever, and providing relief from pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of Distephanus eriophyllus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
